business_summary: China Huarong Energy Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the energy exploration and production businesses. It operates through two segments, Energy Exploration and Production; and Oil Storage and Trading. The company explores for, produces, and sells crude oil and sells petroleum products. It is also involved in commodity trading business; and oil and gas trading, wholesale and distribution activities, as well as provision of oil storage services. The company was formerly known as China Rongsheng Heavy Industries Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to China Huarong Energy Company Limited in April 2015. China Huarong Energy Company Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 China Huarong Energy Company Limited는 에너지 탐사 및 생산 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 에너지 탐사와 생산이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 석유 저장 및 거래. 원유를 탐색, 생산, 판매하고 석유제품을 판매하는 회사입니다. 또한 상품 거래 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 석유 및 가스 거래, 도매 및 유통 활동, 석유 저장 서비스 제공. 이 회사는 이전에 China Rongsheng Heavy Industries Group Holdings Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2015년 4월에 China Huarong Energy Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. China Huarong Energy Company Limited는 2004년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 차이완에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
